intent_en: To demonstrate the massive scale of the Congolese death toll by comparing it to the total population of Belgium.
previous_intent: To illustrate the massive scale of the Congolese death toll between 1885 and 1908 by comparing it to the total population of Belgium in 1890.
narration_support: About 10 million Congolese were executed or starved to death.
chart_support: Bar chart comparing Congolese deaths (1885-1908) to Belgian population (1890), showing the death toll is larger.
evidence_note: Narration quantifies the deaths while the chart visualizes the magnitude by comparing it to a relatable population figure.
